title: Heym before 0.0.148 passes Playwright navigate-step URLs to page.goto() without validating the scheme and runs…
description: Heym versions before 0.0.148 contain a vulnerability where Playwright navigate-step URLs are passed to page.goto() without validating the URL scheme. This allows a signed-in user with workflow execution permissions to navigate to file:// URLs and read sensitive files such as Kubernetes ServiceAccount tokens or Docker secrets from the backend container.
